findings.body: Containment under teacher-warmup-boundary does not bind before/after phase or rank. A rank0 receipt can name rank3.pt, a before receipt can name an after or chunk boundary, and a missing path can still satisfy resolve equality. This weakens the intended independent current-run RNG proof.
findings.required_fix: Require before receipt path == boundary/before/rank-N.pt, after path == boundary/after/rank-N.pt, restore source == boundary/before/rank-N.pt; verify regular owned existing files and recorded byte sizes by stat only. Do not read tensor payloads.
findings.title: Bind each RNG receipt to the exact rank and boundary file

findings.body: Searching for the first brace anywhere and accepting raw_decode without checking surrounding or trailing text can turn JSON embedded in a model or QA log message into teacher_partial_progress. Scalar extraction prevents payload output but does not establish that the line is the actual progress event.
findings.required_fix: Strip ANSI and only the known Ray process prefix, then require the remaining full line to be one valid JSON object with the expected stage and integer 512/G5 budgets. Ignore other lines and retain only whitelisted scalar fields.
findings.title: Parse only complete standalone progress JSON lines

limitations: This is a static reader audit, not native warmup/training acceptance.
The added reader reports initial head readiness and actor progress; it does not expose per-formal-outer question-head completion event metadata.
Driver RNG restoration has no independent persisted readback in BF4; the reader correctly labels that scope.
scope: Only the added inspect-warmup reader and its action routing; prior three action behavior was not re-reviewed.
